AS BUILT — WHERE THE BENCH OVERRULED THE MODEL
• Sub-frame upright at x 253.7, flush with the front (model 251, 3 back) — only the sill panel bridges to it, so only the
• Rail gaps up to 6 mm off the spacers → every side tile cut to its own band per side (left 71.2 / 155 / 85.5, right 65.4 /
• PSU feet 155.5 apart and 150 tall on them → right cradles v4 / v5, AWG arms 8 → 5 mm; the PSU sits very slightly skewed
• Sled front droops past the foot → front rests on the rail tops and splice bars over the P7 joint; the box lifts 7.5 over
• Door edge 347 → 338 (7 over the scope rail); no drawer lids (D14) and no drawer stops (D15); strips 15 LEDs each, not 28;
sled travel 92 to the TPU caps
• Not built, by choice: the probe hanger and the rear-right cable clips
